import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_35/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_35/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source2_35_0 and Source2_35_1 on 'Date'
joined = pd.merge(df0[['Date', 'ResultDir']], df1[['Date', 'NumMosquitos']], on='Date', how='inner')

# Group by Date and ResultDir, aggregate average NumMosquitos
agg = joined.groupby(['Date', 'ResultDir'], as_index=False)['NumMosquitos'].mean()

# Ensure column types match target schema:
# 'Date': string (object)
agg['Date'] = agg['Date'].astype(str)
# 'ResultDir': float
agg['ResultDir'] = agg['ResultDir'].astype(float)
# 'NumMosquitos': float
agg['NumMosquitos'] = agg['NumMosquitos'].astype(float)

# Save to target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/target_multisource.csv"
agg.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'Date' column (inner join by default)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Date", how="inner")

# Group by 'Date' (string, leftmost key column in target)
# Aggregate average of ResultDir (float) and NumMosquitos (float)
result = joined.groupby("Date", as_index=False).agg({
    "ResultDir": "mean",
    "NumMosquitos": "mean"
})

# Ensure column order and names exactly as target schema
result = result[["Date", "ResultDir", "NumMosquitos"]]

# Write output CSV without index
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
